# HRCCoatings Inc

> Professional painting, coating, and refinishing company serving San Diego County since 2003. Family-run father-and-son team specializing in interior painting, exterior painting, commercial painting, epoxy flooring, cabinet refinishing, and more.

## Company Overview
HRCCoatings Inc is a professional painting and coating company based in San Diego, California. Founded in 2003 by Hector Rivera, it is a family-run, faith-based business now co-owned with his son Junior Rivera. They serve residential and commercial clients throughout San Diego County with a focus on premium materials, honest communication, and craftsmanship that lasts.

## Services Offered

### 1. Interior Painting
Residential interior painting including living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, ceilings, trim, doors, and crown molding. Includes color consultations, surface prep, drywall repair, primer application, and multiple coats of premium paint. Most rooms completed in 1-2 days.

### 2. Exterior Painting
Full home exterior painting including siding, stucco, trim, doors, garage doors, fascia, soffits, and shutters. Specialized weather-resistant coatings for San Diego's coastal climate. Pressure washing, scraping, caulking, priming, and 2 coats of premium exterior paint included. Typical projects take 3-7 days.

### 3. Commercial Painting
Professional painting for offices, retail spaces, warehouses, restaurants, medical facilities, schools, and tenant improvements. After-hours and weekend scheduling available to minimize business disruption. Insured and licensed for commercial work.

### 4. Epoxy Flooring
Premium epoxy floor coatings for garages, basements, workshops, and commercial spaces. Available in flake, metallic, and solid color systems. Includes concrete grinding, crack repair, primer, base coat, decorative flake or metallic pigment, and 2 layers of polyurethane topcoat. Lasts 10-20 years.

### 5. Concrete Polishing
Budget-friendly alternative to epoxy. Mechanical grinding and polishing of concrete floors to achieve a sleek, modern, industrial finish. Great for garages and commercial spaces.

### 6. Cabinet Refinishing
Kitchen and bathroom cabinet refinishing. Includes hardware removal, deep cleaning, sanding, bonding primer, and 2-3 coats of premium cabinet paint. Sprayed for a factory-quality finish. Available in any color.

### 7. Drywall Repair
Patching, hole repair, crack repair, water damage repair, and texture matching. Tape, mud, sand, and prime to paint-ready condition.

### 8. Stucco Repair
Crack repair, hole patching, texture matching (smooth, sand, lace, knockdown, Spanish), and protective elastomeric coatings. Specialized for San Diego's coastal humidity.

### 9. Wallpaper Installation & Removal
Professional wallpaper installation, pattern matching, seam alignment, and removal services for residential and commercial spaces.

### 10. Popcorn Ceiling Removal
Complete popcorn ceiling removal including dust containment, scraping, smoothing, skim coating, and refinishing. Modernizes any room.

## Process Overview
Every HRCCoatings project follows a consistent 3-step process:

1. **Free Estimate**: On-site visit where Hector or Junior listens to your goals, measures the space, identifies prep needs, and sends a detailed written quote within 24 hours. No pressure, no obligation, no upsell tactics.

2. **Schedule & Prep**: Pick a start date that works for your schedule. The team arrives on time, protects your furniture, floors, and landscaping, and completes professional surface preparation (cleaning, scraping, sanding, patching, priming) before any paint is applied.

3. **Premium Finish**: Application of 2-3 coats of premium Benjamin Moore, Sherwin Williams, or Dunn-Edwards paint with proper drying time between coats. Final walkthrough together to ensure 100% satisfaction. Touch-ups included.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a painting project cost?
Project costs vary based on size, surface condition, paint selection, and prep work required. A 2-bedroom interior typically ranges from $1,500-$4,000. A full exterior on a 2,000 sq ft home typically ranges from $4,000-$8,000. HRCCoatings provides free, detailed estimates with no obligation so you know the exact cost before committing.

### How long does a typical painting project take?
Most residential interior projects are completed within 2-5 days. A full exterior typically takes 3-7 days. Commercial projects vary based on scope. A clear timeline is provided with every estimate.

### Does HRCCoatings work on weekends?
Yes, HRCCoatings is available 7 days a week from 7 AM to 5 PM. Weekend scheduling is common for both residential and commercial projects.

### What paint brands does HRCCoatings use?
HRCCoatings uses premium paints from Benjamin Moore, Sherwin Williams, and Dunn-Edwards. The specific paint and finish is recommended based on the surface, location, and customer preference. Cheap paint is never used.

### Does HRCCoatings offer a warranty?
Yes, all work is backed by a 14-day satisfaction guarantee. If any concerns arise within 14 days of project completion, HRCCoatings will return and make it right at no additional cost.

### How often should I repaint my home's exterior in San Diego?
In San Diego's climate, most homes need exterior repainting every 7-10 years. Coastal homes within 1-2 miles of the ocean (Carlsbad, La Jolla, Pacific Beach, Encinitas, Del Mar) may need repainting every 5-7 years due to salt air exposure. Homes with intense sun exposure on south or west walls may also need more frequent repainting.

### How long does epoxy flooring last?
With proper installation, garage epoxy floors typically last 10-20 years. Commercial or high-traffic areas may see 5-10 years depending on use. HRCCoatings uses commercial-grade epoxy systems with polyurethane topcoats for maximum durability.

### Does HRCCoatings do both residential and commercial work?
Yes, HRCCoatings serves both homeowners and businesses throughout San Diego County, including offices, retail spaces, warehouses, restaurants, medical facilities, schools, and apartment complexes.

### Does HRCCoatings offer color consultations?
Yes, color consultations are included with every interior and exterior painting estimate. Junior and Hector help customers select colors based on lighting, existing decor, architectural style, and personal preference.

### How much prep work is included?
Comprehensive prep work is included in every project: pressure washing (exterior), scraping loose paint, sanding rough surfaces, caulking gaps and seams, patching holes and cracks, and priming bare or stained areas. HRCCoatings believes prep is 70% of a quality paint job.

### Does HRCCoatings move furniture?
Yes, HRCCoatings moves furniture to the center of rooms, covers it with drop cloths, and replaces it after painting at no additional cost. For larger pieces, customers may need to assist with moving or have items already cleared.

### Can HRCCoatings paint cabinets without removing them?
Yes. HRCCoatings can refinish cabinets in place by removing doors and drawers for off-site spraying while masking and brushing the cabinet boxes on-site. This minimizes kitchen downtime.

### Is HRCCoatings licensed and insured?
Yes, HRCCoatings is fully licensed and insured for residential and commercial work in California. Proof of insurance is available upon request.

### What happens if it rains during my exterior project?
HRCCoatings monitors weather forecasts daily. If rain is expected, painting is paused and rescheduled. Surfaces are protected, and the project resumes when conditions allow. Customers are not charged for weather delays.

### Does HRCCoatings offer financing?
HRCCoatings does not currently offer in-house financing but accepts all major credit cards, check, cash, Venmo, and Zelle. For larger projects, payment plans can be discussed during the estimate.
